title: Dark Jedi Lightsaber
caption: Dark Jedi Lightsaber (V)
game_text: Deploy on Aurra Sing or Sidious. May add 1 to Force drain at an {episode1} site where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Add number of Jedi present. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value.
lore: Multifaceted jewels focus light into a deadly blade. Projects a meter-long beam of pure energy. A lightsaber is constructed personally by a Jedi as a part of training.
copyright: TM & © 1995 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1995 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Non-unique (no dot; printed Unrestricted). Green Character Weapon frame, banner CHARACTER WEAPON. Inline black 'EPISODE I' circle → {episode1}. No margin credits. The wiki 'Dark Jedi Lightsaber' page is the printed archive face (Premiere-D-darkjedilightsaber-decipher-archive.gif, 350×490 — a square-on scan, used as src). LORE: the printed scan reads 'Mutlifaceted' (Decipher's misprint, clearly legible) where the wiki and the 745 px PC face (Premiere-D-darkjedilightsaber.gif, errata face, downloaded to src/vs12/30-… for art only) read 'Multifaceted' — transcribed as printed; Bill may prefer the corrected spelling. Copyright 'TM & © 1995 …' legible. Modern: V11-D-darkjedilightsaber.gif (745 px, Virtual Set 11 remake — same art, its lore spells 'Multifaceted'); VB5 -pre also exists, not downloaded. Printed card misspells 'Mutlifaceted'; corrected (lore typos fixed, Bill).
